panels.description: Sitara scans selected maintenance records while Nayah watches frost shake from the ceiling. Leave upper-left for sound effect and lower-left for dialogue.
Sitara overlays drilling and ice-motion plots; a narrow red line shows local acceleration while the wider Antarctic trend remains separate. Leave upper-left clear.
Warning light flashes and meltwater beads at the threshold as Nayah pulls the emergency line toward the exit; Sitara closes the tablet. Leave upper corners clear.
Copied record clearly shows NEXUS — ROUTE 2 — SECOND TIMESTAMP and PAIR BEFORE DISCLOSURE. Keep document readable.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: Then the copy has to be complete.

items.speaker: SITARA
items.text: Local acceleration. Not the whole system.
